_comment: The COLD self-hop diff counts on record — the reference range for the 5b self-hop gate (docs/rust-port/00-control.md §3, '5b self-hop gate', 2026-09-25). Every cold self-hop on record differs because a cold leg replays nothing and the LLM re-rolls; 'self-hop = 0' was replaced by: cold count inside this range AND a warm leg (replaying a copy of the cold leg's own cache) byte-identical with 0 writes. Read from each label's 2.1.216-self-hop.json (results dirs are not committed). Judged by experiments/lib/invariants.ts coldRangeVerdict. Only valid for `version`: a self-hop on another version has no range on record.
